explication: Istio is a Kubernetes-integrated service mesh. Users submit mesh configuration or install commands through istioctl and the operator. Istiod observes Kubernetes and external service registries, builds an abstract service model, translates routing and security policy into proxy configuration, and distributes it over xDS. Envoy sidecars or ambient ztunnel then secure and route workload traffic while producing telemetry. The CNI and repair controllers prepare and maintain node networking. Several relationships are inferred from documented responsibilities because only sampled controller excerpts were available.
